text:
The parser is not down — I checked the transcript directly rather than trusting my own view of it.

**Evidence the tee ran on this seat:**
- Transcript record at 07:39:59 (line 43 of `e126cb02….jsonl`) is my assistant turn, and its content **starts with the receipt sentence** — the 956 B dm body ("Your message crossed the reload…") is gone from that record and only the receipt + the operator-facing prose remain. That's the rewrite working. The full body sits in `~/.clodex/spill/clodex/1f2480d237b4208c.md` (956 B, 07:39).
- The only other occurrences of that dm's text in the transcript are the receipt's own 80-char quote and my later prose about it.
- `intentSpill` is unset in ui-settings → defaults to `'on'` (`stores.js:106`).

What you're probably seeing: only ONE intent body from this seat has crossed the 800-byte threshold (`SPILL_MIN_BYTES`, `intent-spill.js:10`). Everything else I've emitted since reload — log lines, the short dm to wirescope (~400 B), the answers to you — is under it, so there is legitimately nothing else to spill. The "@spill" strings in my transcript are all discussion, not receipts, which matches a working parser with one event.

**On "never type" being an elephant:** you're right, and that is exactly why t1047 didn't stop at rewording. The line is only half of it; the structural half is that the pointer shape is no longer something I could plausibly emit. Old receipt: `@spill:1f2480d237b4208c` — a short token, and the prompt named it, so five out of thirteen bodies pre-restart were me emitting the token instead of the body. New receipt: a sentence containing a quoted prefix of what I wrote, a byte count, and an absolute path — I can't produce a correct one without having written the body, and a mimicked one is detected (`mimicKindOf`, `intent-spill.js:119`) and bounced as unresolved rather than silently accepted. So the defence is "the thing I'd fabricate no longer exists as a valid form", not "don't think about it". The prompt line is now phrased positively ("a body you did not write does not exist") — no token in it for me to reproduce.

Whether that holds is the after-count wirescope will run once ~12 long bodies have left this seat; n=1 so far, clean.
